units.source_text: 源氏公子和头中将想起了适才听到的琴声，觉得那所荒凉的邸宅实在古怪，便兴味津津地联想种种情状。

en.t: Prince Genji and To no Chujo remembered the sound of the koto they had just heard, and, finding that desolate mansion truly strange, began imagining all sorts of circumstances with great curiosity.

units.source_text: 头中将耽入空想：“这个美丽可爱的人儿孤苦伶仃地在那里度送了悠长的年月，如果我首先发现了她，依依地恋慕她，

en.t: To no Chujo sank into reverie: If that beautiful, lovely woman had spent long years there all alone, and if I had been the first to discover her and had fallen tenderly in love with her,

units.source_text: 那时世人一定议论纷纷，而我也不胜相思之苦了。”

en.t: then people would surely have talked endlessly, and I too would have been unable to bear the pain of longing for her.

units.source_text: 又想：“源氏公子早有用心，特地去访，决不会就此罢休。”

en.t: Then he thought again: Prince Genji must have had some intention from the start; since he went there deliberately to visit, he will certainly not leave matters as they are.

units.source_text: 想到这里，不免妒火中烧，心情不安。

en.t: Thinking this, he could not help burning with jealousy, and his heart grew uneasy.
